culprit_citations.quoted_text: Total Investments (108.0%) | $231,571,333 amortized cost | $230,281,379 fair value

rationale: The filing schedule reports March 31, 2026 total investment fair value of $230,281,379 and explicitly labels it 108.0% of net assets. The balance sheet reports members' capital of $213,530,000; $230,281,379 / $213,530,000 = 107.84%, which rounds to the filed 108.0%. The queued aggregate of $544,170,799 is therefore overstated by $313,889,420. The schedule contains position rows plus debt, equity, cash-equivalent, combined, and grand-total rows, supporting subtotal leakage as the aggregate mechanism, but the evidence does not safely isolate one included subtotal combination, so localized is false.
